spaced_repetition.name: Spaced Repetition
spaced_repetition.description: Distributing study sessions over time with increasing intervals to exploit the spacing effect and strengthen long-term retention.

retrieval_practice.name: Retrieval Practice
retrieval_practice.description: Actively pulling information from memory (via quizzes, flashcards, or free recall) rather than passively re-reading, which strengthens memory traces.

interleaving.name: Interleaving
interleaving.description: Mixing different topics or problem types within a single study session instead of practicing one type at a time (blocked practice).

elaboration.name: Elaboration
elaboration.description: Generating explanations, connections to prior knowledge, and personal examples to build richer mental models of new material.

metacognition.name: Metacognition
metacognition.description: Thinking about your own thinking — monitoring comprehension, judging what you know vs. don't know, and choosing effective strategies.

desirable_difficulties.name: Desirable Difficulties
desirable_difficulties.description: Introducing challenges (spacing, interleaving, retrieval) that slow initial learning but produce stronger long-term retention and transfer.
